items.heading: Pcm Is a Stream
items.text: PCM is a stream. Coding is a skill. One decides which doors your Class 12 marksheet can open, and the other decides what you can show once you walk through.

items.heading: Use This Table to See
items.text: Use this table to see where your effort pays back, and where it only feels productive. A coding certificate never replaces the stream at the seat step.

items.heading: Plan By Stage and Outcome,
items.text: Plan by stage and outcome, not by hours counted. Class 12 asks far more of you than Class 8 does, so the split should change as you move up.

items.heading: Subject Rules Are Set Branch
items.text: Subject rules are set branch by branch. In the 2022-23 AICTE handbook, as Careers360 reported it , computer science, electronics and electrical engineering needed Physics and Mathematics in Class 12, and several other branches added Chemistry.

items.heading: Colleges Apply This in Practice
items.text: Colleges apply this in practice. One university's 2026 B.Tech page asks for at least 50% in Physics and Mathematics for its computer science, electronics and electrical branches (45% for SC, ST and OBC).

items.heading: Jee Advanced Takes Only
items.text: JEE Advanced takes only the top 2,50,000 JEE Main rankers, with at most two attempts in two consecutive years, as the eSaral guide summarises the 2026 rules. Rules change each cycle, so read the notice on the NTA JEE Main site and the JEE Advanced site .
